title: Apply for an individual contractor licence
summary: Learn about the requirements and steps to apply for an individual contractor licence in NSW.
intro:
Builders and tradespeople in NSW need to be licensed to do building work where the total cost of labour and materials is more than $5,000.

Licence applications must be lodged at a service centre and you can book an appointment online.
who_can_apply: Must be a builder or tradesperson in NSW.
The building work must have a total cost of labour and materials exceeding $5,000.
what_you_need: Evidence of qualifications (certificates and transcripts from the registered training organisation).
A certificate of eligibility to obtain insurance (if applicable).

how_to_steps.text: Attend your appointment with your application documents and payment.
your application will be assessed by Building Commission NSW on set criteria for:
if Building Commission NSW contacts you to ask for more information the processing time may increase
you will be notified about the result of your application when the assessment is completed.

more_info.text: You're legally required to display your licence number on all advertising, stationery and signage.
Once your licence has been issued, you can use the Service NSW app to access it digitally.

faqs.q: Who needs an individual contractor licence?
faqs.a: Builders and tradespeople in NSW need to be licensed if the total cost of labour and materials for the building work is more than $5,000.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You must lodge your application at a service centre. You can book an appointment online before attending.
Building Commission NSW will assess your application based on set criteria. You will be notified of the result once the assessment is complete.
